# WidgetForge

WidgetForge is a small toolkit for forging demo widgets in a test furnace.
It exists so fixture projects have something realistic to describe.

## Usage

Heat the furnace, place the blank, and call the forge routine once per widget.
The usage paragraph mentions the bellows only in passing.

## Layout

The package lives under src/widgetforge with one module per furnace station.
Entry points are declared in pyproject.toml under project scripts.
